contract.purpose: Required immutable dependency;30 runtime qualification still open

implementation: Existing ACPIPLAT owns processor/legacy-Processor discovery, MADT UID/APIC mapping, _CPC or _PSS/_PCT parsing, optional _PSD/_PPC, GAS validation and all actual firmware/control/status work on its existing external platform worker.

Independent fixed CpuFirmwareInfo192/CpuFirmwareBackend32 and optional DriverCpuPowerApi168/R4DEV28-648 tails preserve all previous fixed records/slots/constants and outer DriverApi37. No AML or hardware model policy in the kernel.

CPUPOWER has a separately typed blocking firmware adapter. Old HWP/CPPC current-CPU Sessions retain their nonblocking/local meanings. Kernel firmware routing keeps exact two provider identities, task admission, whole-domain CPU membership and active callback counts; no Runtime/IRQ/local-register owner spans AML or waits.

One domain leader handles a complete validated _PSD cohort. SW_ALL/HW_ALL require nonaliasing member controls; SW_ANY requires exactly shared controls. Mixed CPPC/PSS, missing members, bad ranges, malformed/unsupported descriptors and aliasing domains refuse before ownership or register writes.

Initial reversible transports: SystemIO and already permanent correctly mapped SystemMemory. CPPC supports already enabled autonomous min/max/desired plus optional EPP; no new sticky activation. PSS uses declared nonzero ranks rather than MHz. _CPC supersedes legacy methods, including when present but invalid/unsupported.

Exclusive domain admission excludes every direct HWP/CPPC token in that domain. Capture exact original words after admission; compare full words for conflicts and return. Public fingerprints never authorize hardware equality or replace retained original words.

Coordinated P-state requests and restores reach all required members before any status wait, including hardware that only acknowledges a complete group. All member status/readback receipts and real lease release precede successful return.

A bounded resident submission cell copies requests and wakes the existing platform worker. Ordinary callback tasks use ordinary admitted task sleep. Once submitted, the caller/task/providers stay resident until actual completion; timeout never frees live AML or replays a possible write.

Stop closes new apply requests, drains admitted work and keeps namespace/worker/modules/cohort until exact existing returns and callback completion. Firmware notifications withdraw the catalogue while retaining sensor-independent original return; changed catalogues require module restart.

PowerService falls back only after both direct providers report unsupported, never after disabled/uncertain ownership. Private independent firmware records retain exact firmware generation/domain/descriptor identity and decoded parameters. A first actual new-provider acquisition receipt is retained for return; changed owned identities quarantine the old token.

Common fixed PowerCpuProfileInfo raw HWP/CPPC words/request-valid bits remain unavailable for firmware. Firmware fingerprints never populate raw MSR fields. Summary masks expand only a confirmed leader whole-domain receipt; followers never invent independent tokens. PSS nominal/efficient fields in this common record remain unknown.

SYSINFO /CPUFW:<cpu> explicitly queries the independent firmware receipt; profile UI directs firmware parameter inspection there. The Test plan explicitly includes/loads ACPIPLAT while normal optional IMAGE_SCOPE=none remains. Existing profile config/IPC/placement/return/system-transition contracts remain.

source_qualification.canonical_private_c_wire_field_layout: all request/receipt sizes, alignments and field offsets checked against canonical Zig ABI at compilation

source_audit.role: ACPIPLAT owns package/GAS/MADT/AML/register/return work on its existing platform worker. CPUPOWER has separate blocking typed adapter; PowerService owns profiles and leader/domain masks. Kernel retains exact two providers/task/cohort and excludes direct control on all domain members; no interpreter or policy in kernel.
source_audit.manual_review: Original words captured after exclusive admission; full-word comparisons authorize ownership/return, opaque fingerprints only in independent CpuFirmwareInfo. Old fixed profile raw words/request-valid bits unavailable for firmware; controller keeps private decoded request/generation/domain confirmation. All P-state domain requests/restores are submitted before status waits. No Runtime/IRQ/local-register Session across callback or wait. Ordinary admitted callers use ordinary task sleep; dedicated AML/status work uses its own driver worker. Catalogue withdrawal retains original token and sensor-independent return. Incomplete/aliasing/mixed/unsupported domains refuse before control. All old fixed records/slots/constants and15 functional owners unchanged.

source_audit.limits: Real local KVM SMP4 only. Initial already exposed SystemIO/mapped SystemMemory CPPC/PSS; PCC/FFH/_OSC grants, new sticky enable, changed catalogue re-publication and native physical actuation/energy remain unqualified/unavailable. No host CPU/remote hardware probes.

runtime.limits: Real local KVM SMP4 including one logical offline CPU. HWP/CPPC inspect are explicitly unavailable, apply/enable/new named IDs reject before instruction with unchanged output and zero added MSR faults. Actual supported native HWP/CPPC writes/energy/operating frequency/firmware coexistence are unqualified; real driver/kernel-source fixtures mock the hardware peer. No host CPU probe or remote machine used. External PowerService profile/status/configuration/restart/real worker join and cooperative preterminal return are verified in the real guest; supported physical parameter writes are tested only with simulated provider peers. No measured physical clock/energy/thermal effect.

power_service.actual_join_receipts: All14 steady snapshots have live worker_count0; the existing second24-case selftest additionally checks exact perCPU provider/generation/no-control/completed-worker receipts on all4 online CPUs. live clears only on actual threadHandleJoin0; captured-entry/timeout/abnormal-exit source cases verify owner behavior.

firmware.qualified: Actual KVM4 external worker transport with absent performance objects; no actuation or physical energy claim.

standard.limits: Exactly one final normal Suite3/all4 observation. Explicit HWP/CPPC unsupported/refusal checks run in the separate scoped functional guest; ACPIPLAT is loaded but no native control request or physical power effect is measured by this virtual benchmark. Workloads, fixed reference and score method unchanged. No physical power/accuracy/scaling or isolated speedup claim.

preliminary.reason: Independent firmware fingerprints must never populate fixed PowerCpuProfileInfo raw HWP/CPPC request fields. Keep those fields/validity unavailable for firmware; use private decoded parameter confirmation and public independent CpuFirmwareInfo192. Existing field meanings and old backend records stay unchanged.
preliminary.runtime_candidate: In progress on immutable existing Quick source; retain raw outcome as preliminary, no benchmark started.

preliminary_runtime.limit: Old normalization candidate only. No supported firmware control exists in this KVM guest. Exact-source final guest required after fixing fixed raw profile field semantics and coordinated P-state completion ordering. No STANDARD on this candidate.

limits: Real local KVM SMP4 only, including logical offline/online. The actual loaded ACPIPLAT namespace/worker route returns no supported performance objects on this guest. It proves missing-contract handling and exact callback transport, not supported physical actuation.

IO/MMIO CPPC/PSS and group/return behavior are actual owner/uACPI source cases against synthetic hardware. Native clock, boost, energy, thermal response and firmware/SMI coexistence remain unqualified. No remote/OssiPC/native-host CPU probes or Windows runtime test.

PCC, unqualified FFH, new _OSC grants, new sticky CPPC activation, complex/unsupported domains and live catalogue re-publication are unavailable. No invented capability or fallback from present invalid _CPC. Normal profiles retain optional driver selection.

PSS provides no autonomous bounds/EPP controller: saving selects the lowest declared rank; balanced/performance select the highest nominal declared state. Common raw HWP/CPPC fields stay unavailable; independent firmware parameters are explicit.

Exactly one final normal Suite3/all4 observation on the final source/artifact state; original complete30-sample export and six valid full DevCenter readbacks. Workload/reference/scoring unchanged. ACPIPLAT is an additional loaded background owner; no isolated causal speedup or physical energy inference.
